title: Child Location App
scenario: An unknown app says it lets parents track children for free but asks for contacts.

answers.A: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.B: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.C: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.
answers.D: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.

explanation: Child Location App: the trap is to pull you away from the normal verification path. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Family safety apps should be vetted before permissions are granted.
